Yes, the buyer is likely to prevail, so the answer is C. The custom-made shutters were screwed and bracketed into the window frames, which makes them fixtures under the annexation, adaptation and intent factors. Fixtures pass with the home even though the sales agreement didn't mention them. The repair and repainting (B) doesn't change what was conveyed, and the deed covenants (D) concern title, not removed fixtures.

CONFIDENCE: 90
